write_file({"path": "pipeline/models/locations.sql", "content": "with staff as (
    select
        e.locationid,
        e.firstname || ' ' || e.lastname as full_name,
        e.lastname,
        e.performance,
        p.positiontitle,
        to_double(replace(replace(e.salary, 'US$', ''), ',', '')) as salary_amount
    from employee e
    left join position p on p.positionid = e.positionid
),
ranked as (
    select
        locationid,
        full_name,
        row_number() over (partition by locationid order by salary_amount desc, lastname asc) as salary_rank
    from staff
),
counts as (
    select
        locationid,
        count(*) as num_employees,
        sum(case when positiontitle = 'Trainee' then 1 else 0 end) as num_of_trainee,
        sum(case when positiontitle = 'Account Representative' and performance = 'Average' then 1 else 0 end)
            as num_account_representatives_with_average_performance,
        sum(case when performance = 'Good' then 1 else 0 end) as num_employees_have_good_perfomance
    from staff
    group by locationid
)
select
    l.locationid as location_id,
    l.state as location_state,
    l.address as location_address,
    coalesce(c.num_employees, 0) as num_employees,
    r.full_name as highest_paid_employee,
    coalesce(c.num_of_trainee, 0) as num_of_trainee,
    coalesce(c.num_account_representatives_with_average_performance, 0)
        as num_account_representatives_with_average_performance,
    coalesce(c.num_employees_have_good_perfomance, 0) as num_employees_have_good_perfomance
from location l
left join counts c on c.locationid = l.locationid
left join ranked r on r.locationid = l.locationid and r.salary_rank = 1"})

write_file({"path": "pipeline/models/positions.sql", "content": "with employee_salary as (
    select
        positionid,
        gender,
        performance,
        to_double(replace(replace(salary, 'US$', ''), ',', '')) as salary_amount
    from employee
)
select
    p.positionid as position_id,
    p.positiontitle as position_title,
    p.educationrequired as education_required,
    coalesce(sum(case when e.performance = 'Poor' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as num_poor_performing_employees,
    coalesce(sum(case when e.gender = 'F' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as num_female_employees,
    100.0 * sum(case when e.salary_amount > 20000 then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(count(e.positionid), 0)
        as per_salary_over_20000,
    avg(e.salary_amount) as avg_salary,
    case
        when to_double(replace(replace(p.maxsalary, 'US$', ''), ',', '')) <= 70000 then 1
        else 0
    end as has_maximum_salary_no_more_than_70000
from position p
left join employee_salary e on e.positionid = p.positionid
group by p.positionid, p.positiontitle, p.educationrequired, p.maxsalary"})
